Leah (AE): Heads-up: Prospect 'BlueCove Logistics' wants to run an auth/identity POC. Main asks from their security/infra: EU data residency, BYOK/KMS, SCIM audit trails, and a clear Dedicated pricing quote if reserved capacity is needed. Can SE/PS/sec triage?
Raj (Solutions Eng): Cool. Quick clarifying Qs: do they need SAML-only SSO or OAuth/OIDC for apps too? SP-initiated preferred? Also, SCIM scope: full user lifecycle + group sync + custom attributes? Any existing group->role mapping schema?
Tara (PS): We'll need expected monthly tokens and peak concurrent requests to size Dedicated. If they want formal SLA and pinned GPUs we need a committed monthly figure. Ballpark numbers ok for initial quote.
Leah (AE): They said primary SSO is Okta + a handful of Azure AD tenants. SP-initiated is fine. SCIM: full lifecycle + groups; they want audit trail visibility for provisioning events. They also flagged domain verification across multiple domains (bluecove.com + eu.bluecove.com).
Raj (Solutions Eng): Tech notes to share with them:
- SAML: support HTTP-POST/Redirect, optional encrypted assertions (AES-256). We can accept signed AuthnRequests or unsigned. Need their IdP metadata XML. Example ACS entry to provide to Okta:
```
<AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://eu.bluecove.redwood.example/sso/acs\"/>
```
- SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 with PATCH and incremental delta retrieval. Sample SCIM filter to fetch suspended users:
```
GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=active eq false
```
- Audit: provisioning events are emitted to our audit log stream; we can redact attributes (PII) on export.
Mateo (Security): From the questionnaire: require BYOK for encryption-at-rest + key rotation policy + proof of SOC2/ISO. We have SOC2 Type II cert and can support customer-managed keys via KMS (GCP/AWS/Azure). Will attach cert and a BYOK integration guide.
Tara (PS): Pricing sketch: Hosted POC (2 weeks) = free credits + usage. Dedicated (reserved): small footprint (2x A10G equiv) ~ $12k/mo, mid (4x) ~$22k/mo, large (8x) ~$40k/mo. Enterprise add-ons: KMS integration + extended audit retention (+$2k/mo), private VPC (+$8k/mo). Discounts for 12/24 month terms.
Leah (AE): Legal asked for short canned responses for questions 2.4-2.9 by EOD Wed. Can security/ps prepare short bullets + attachments (SOC2 PDF, BYOK guide, sample pen-test summary)?
Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a tech checklist and a minimal config playbook for Okta + Azure AD including ACS/EntityID examples, SCIM attribute mappings, and group->role mapping sample (group.displayName -> app_role). Will post to shared folder.
Mateo (Security): I'll prepare the compliance pack and a short note about audit retention and SCIM logs redaction options. Also confirm: they want logs pushed to their SIEM? We can support syslog/forwarder or S3 export.
infra-bot: POC workspace provisioned: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-bluecove (id: poc-blue-202406). Invitations sent to poc@bluecove.com :white_check_mark:
Tara (PS): I'll create three committed scenarios (3/6/12 month) with estimated monthly commit and discount tiers, include run-rate for multi-domain support and extended audit.
Leah (AE): Timeline they suggested: kickoff next Monday, 10-business-day POC, final decision in 21 days. Owners: Raj = SE tasks, Tara = pricing, Mateo = security.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Need their Okta metadata + a sample CSV of users (incl. groups/roles) for initial import test. Can Leah request those assets?
Leah (AE): Yep, pinged them and asked to upload to the shared folder. Tagged their admin contact in the email.
Mateo (Security): Note: if they insist on EU-only residency and BYOK we should propose either (a) Dedicated in EU region or (b) Private deployment. Private deploy ETA ~ 6-9 weeks depending on approval.
Tara (PS): I'll include cost delta for Private vs Dedicated in the pricing doc.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Small config snippet for group->role mapping to share: `{\"groupName\":\"ops-team\",\"mappedRole\":\"infrastructure:operator\"}` 44d
Leah (AE): Great. Let's aim to consolidate answers + attachments and send to BlueCove legal by Wed EOD. Thanks team. :pray:
(threads end)
